description: Edit or transform a local image with Stability AI Image Services on AWS Bedrock: fill or erase a masked area, extend the canvas, swap or recolor an object found by a prompt, remove the background, upscale, draw from a sketch or structure, or apply a style. Saves the result as a PNG, like bedrock_generate_image.

change_strength.description: style-transfer: how much the input may change (default 0.9)

composition_fidelity.description: style-transfer: how closely the output keeps the input's composition (default 0.9)

control_strength.description: control-sketch, control-structure: how closely the output follows the input (default 0.7)

creativity.description: upscale-conservative and upscale-creative (0.1-0.5), outpaint (0.1-1): how much new detail to invent

down.description: outpaint: pixels to add at the bottom

fidelity.description: style-guide: how closely the output follows the input image's style (default 0.5)

grow_mask.description: inpaint, erase, search-replace, search-recolor: pixels to grow and soften the mask edge (default 5)

image_path.description: Input image (PNG, JPEG or WebP), absolute or relative to cwd. For style-transfer, the image to restyle.

left.description: outpaint: pixels to add on the left

mask_path.description: inpaint, erase: black-and-white mask image, white where the image should change. Without it, the input image's alpha channel is used as the mask.

negative_prompt.description: What to keep out of the output

operation.description: What to do: inpaint (needs prompt); outpaint (needs one of left/right/up/down); erase; remove-background; search-replace (needs prompt, search_prompt); search-recolor (needs prompt, select_prompt); upscale-fast; upscale-conservative (needs prompt); upscale-creative (needs prompt); control-sketch (needs prompt); control-structure (needs prompt); style-guide (needs prompt); style-transfer (needs style_image_path)

output_dir.description: Directory to save the image, as in bedrock_generate_image (BEDROCK_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR, cwd or ~/bedrock-images)

output_format.description: Result file format (default png; webp for the three upscale operations, whose PNG is over Bedrock's 16 MB response limit)

right.description: outpaint: pixels to add on the right

search_prompt.description: search-replace: the object to find and replace

select_prompt.description: search-recolor: the object to find and recolor

style_image_path.description: style-transfer: the image whose style is applied

style_preset.description: Style preset, for the operations that take one

style_strength.description: style-transfer: how strongly the style image applies (default 1)

up.description: outpaint: pixels to add on top

name: bedrock_edit_image
